name: mcorucu/mclogiora
description: A modern multilingual platform foundation for WordPress.

scripts.lint: find mclogiora.php uninstall.php src tools -name '*.php' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 -P4 php -l

scripts-descriptions.lint: Checks every PHP file for syntax errors.
scripts-descriptions.phpcbf: Fixes the coding-standard violations that can be fixed automatically.
scripts-descriptions.test: Runs the PHPUnit unit test suite.
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Runs the WordPress integration tests. Requires bin/install-wp-tests.sh first.
scripts-descriptions.pot: Regenerates languages/mclogiora.pot from the shipped source.
scripts-descriptions.check: Runs the full local quality gate. Run this before opening a pull request.
